data.title: Kinderzuschlag approved for Ida and Jonas (December 2026 – May 2027)
data.summary: The Familienkasse Musterlahn approved Johanna Beispielacker's supplementary child benefit (Kinderzuschlag) of €297 per month for each of her children, Ida and Jonas, for December 2026 through May 2027. The letter also mentions that education and participation benefits (Bildung und Teilhabe) must be applied for separately at the local municipality.
data.explanation: This is a decision (Bescheid) from the Familienkasse granting extra child benefit (Kinderzuschlag) for six months. No action is needed to receive the payments — they should arrive automatically. If you want the additional "Bildung und Teilhabe" benefits (e.g. school supplies, meals), you need to apply separately with your city/municipality (Kommune). If you disagree with the amount or the decision, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) with the Familienkasse; the app shows until when you can do this. If you do nothing, the decision becomes final.
